scenes: Bitcoin's first block hides a newspaper headline.
And its fifty Bitcoin can never be spent.
January third, two thousand nine. Satoshi Nakamoto mined block zero.
Inside, he wrote a line from The Times.
Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks.
So the block was not made before that day.
Many see it as a message about the banks.
Plot twist: a quirk in the code makes it unspendable.
Nobody knows if that was on purpose.
And the next block came about six days later.
